notes.title: Ark Nova Digital 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Today’s [i]Ark Nova Digital[/i] patch introduces various improvements and bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/ba6bf7db59ddb63273a81caea8c057521bc91b61.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Revised expand/collapse behavior for windows during various selections.[/p][/*][*][p]Window and modal sizes, positions, and layering should now appear correctly across the UI.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Various localization issues should now be fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Archaeologist should now properly trigger for placement bonuses on the alternate Research Institute map.[/p][/*][*][p]The Research Mission heroic challenge should no longer cause a loss of $10 when saving and rejoining.[/p][/*][*][p]Naturalist Zoo should now clearly reflect its current status.[/p][/*][*][p]Viewing an opponent’s zoo with the Red Tape malus should no longer affect the donation cost display in your own zoo.[/p][/*][*][p]Card hints in the tutorial should now be clearer and more helpful.[/p][/*][*][p]Transition visuals to the landing screen should now display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Zoom speed on tablets should now be quicker.[/p][/*][*][p]Close-ups should now be viewable even while effects are resolving.[/p][/*][*][p]The effects resolution queue should now support scrolling as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Player markers in the break tracker should now be sized properly in solo games.[/p][/*][*][p]The Archaeological Dig heroic challenge should now enforce starting hand limitations even after reopening the game during map selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Players should no longer sometimes be prompted to play a third animal while on Commercial Harbor.[/p][/*][*][p]Display should no longer expand when taking the Animals action when no animals can be played from it.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]The UI does not display 2+ Your continued feedback helps us to make [i]Ark Nova Digital[/i] the best version of itself it can be. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for general improvements, drop us a line! notes.content:

notes.title: Ark Nova Digital 1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]It’s a big day for [i]Ark Nova Digital,[/i] as the Early Access period officially comes to an end with Patch 1.0!  Today’s patch addresses a handful of issues, and brings [i]Ark Nova Digital[/i] to mobile devices![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/0c3caf99b36cd6b179f2bb1c73bb64be4bfb6750.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]New Features and Improvements[/h2][p][i]Ark Nova Digital[/i] is now available on iOS and Android devices![/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Action log now shows Endgame scoring.[/p][/*][*][p]Hotkeys used for rotating buildings now function as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Viewing an opponent’s zoo in the tutorial no longer softlocks the user.[/p][/*][*][p]Heavy Equipment Operator scoring modifier no longer has missing text.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]Statistics for upgrading action cards are not updated in the Player Stats.[/p][/*][*][p]In Solo games, Players can’t Flock animals from the display.[/p][/*][*][p]An Italian description for Reptile Month is incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]The HUD does not display 2+ Multiplier tokens on actions.[/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback throughout the [i]Ark Nova Digital[/i] Early Access period! If you encounter any issues or if anything else in the game that seems off, or have suggestions for general improvements, drop us a line! You can reach us using the in-game feedback option, via email to [url="https://support@direwolfdigital.com"]support@direwolfdigital.com[/url], or by posting to Steam Forums or the [u][url="https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital"]Dire Wolf Discord.[/url][/u] [/p][p]
Thanks for playing [i]Ark Nova Digital![/i][/p]

notes.title: Ark Nova Digital Patch 0.9.10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/19c100aeaec5b8bc3f353941907cf076404342fe.png[/img]
Today’s patch addresses a handful of gameplay fixes for issues identified by the player community.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Sponsor Magnet ability should now trigger immediately when the animal with it is played.
[*] Adding a Multiplier token to an action that is being taken should no longer cause it to trigger immediately.
[*] You should no longer be able to use Breeding Program/Global Breeding Program to support conservation projects that did not start the game in the Association area.
[*] The number of rocks required to support the second level of Geological has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] When you play to the middle slot of Predator Breeding Program, the Deferred ability says you are gaining 1 Rep. You actually gain 2 as the card indicates.
[*] When you sell a card at the end of your turn with Commercial Harbor, and have a Venom token, it is applied twice.
[/list]


As always, if you run into trouble or need any help, please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com, or [url=https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital]join the player community on Discord[/url].  Thanks for playing Ark Nova Digital!

notes.title: Ark Nova Digital Patch 0.9.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/0fd78fa29ae5192ba41c6983dde40c44fd344a11.jpg[/img]

Today’s patch addresses a handful of small fixes for issues identified by the player community.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The effects of Diversity Researcher and Research Institute should now work at the same time when playing animals.
[*] Covering a placement bonus and then undoing should no longer result in being unable to gain that bonus.
[*] Individual windows should no longer get “stuck” on opponents when switching between views.
[*] Added a hover state to clarify that the Score track can be collapsed by selecting the header.
[*] Fixed localization issues in the Action Log.
[*] Venom tokens should now only be in effect if they were on your action(s) at the start of your turn (relevant for the Contagion Challenge).
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players are awarded a conservation bonus when rocks and water are covered in the Diversity Research challenge (rather than at end of game).
[/list]

As always, if you run into trouble or need any help, please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com, or [url=https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital]join the player community on Discord.[/url]  Thanks for playing [i]Ark Nova Digital![/i]

notes.title: Ark Nova Digital Patch 0.9.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/298b430436e96ac7a25f1279bc540c4fc5b299d2.png[/img]
Today’s patch addresses a handful of small fixes for issues identified by the player community.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Biodiverse Zoo will now correctly check the player before you in turn order instead of after.
[*] Special Exhibits which give you a building at the start of the game should now consistently trigger.
[*] Migration Recording will now only work while in play, not in your hand.
[*] The Undo button now has the correct tooltip.
[*] Open windows are now consistently preserved upon resuming a game.
[*] Fixed multiple localization issues with the Special Exhibits.
[*] Fixed a localization issue with warning pop-ups.
[*] Fixed the positioning of the Special Exhibit Leaderboard.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] When you have both Diversity Researcher and have connected the Research Institute on the map of the same name, you can't use both effects on the same animal.
[*] Players are awarded a conservation bonus when rocks and water are covered in the Diversity Research challenge (rather than at end of game).
[*] If you decline a Clever placement bonus, then undo your turn, covering it again won’t give you the Clever effect.
[/list]

As always, if you run into trouble or need any help, please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com, or join the [url=https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital]player community on Discord[/url].  Thanks for playing Ark Nova Digital!

notes.title: Ark Nova Digital Patch 0.9.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/c5609d233e41990c51cdbacc182b31147f35614a.png[/img]

Today’s patch addresses a handful of small fixes for issues identified by the player community.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed the white box which would sometimes appear on the Player History.
[*] Players will no longer be prompted to use the Commercial Harbor map ability when they first connect to it or after they complete an action (they can still activate it manually).
[*] The headers for each area now provide visual feedback to indicate that they can be selected to collapse that area
[*] The Research Institute is now visible on the map during map selection.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] The “Disable Opponent Animations” toggle is misleading. The toggle turns off opponent action presentation, not animations.
[*] The “Heavy Equipment Operator” scoring mod displays as a text string in the rewards screen.
[*] Pressing “.” in chat incorrectly removes you from a game lobby.
[/list]

As always, if you run into trouble or need any help, please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com, or join the [url=https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital]player community on Discord[/url].  Thanks for playing [i]Ark Nova Digital[/i]!

notes.title: Ark Nova Digital Patch 0.9.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/abc0321de30f7a030267d8d178a4f800396cac37.png[/img]

Today’s patch introduces Polish-language support, and addresses a number of minor bugs and improvements. [i]Witaj w grze![/i]

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Support for Polish localization has been added.[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]

notes.title: Ark Nova Digital 0.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/63a1e2b4c43dfc7a77cbcce867ade2219559da8b.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow zookeepers! We have a number of new features, bug fixes, and free bonus content to announce with this patch. 

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Promo Cards[/h3]
Two new promo cards—Promotion Team and Capybara—have been added to the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/b4be383f3790e3b9632ea47cddcc853f59651704.jpg[/img]

[h3]Animal Avatars[/h3]
By popular request, a dozen animal avatars have been added to the game. From the regal lion to the playful dusky leaf monkey, there’s an animal for every mood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/ff2ec5cc36f8dba5d5f7672b94158ca22a77b079.jpg[/img]

[h3]Alternative Map Pack[/h3]
Spice up your games with eight new variant maps, each offering a fresh take on familiar zoo theme. 

[h3]UI Scale[/h3]
Based on community feedback, UI scale options have been added to settings, allowing you to adjust HUD element sizes to your preference.

[h3]AI Improvements[/h3]
Over a dozen AI improvements have been made, and the AI is now more strategic than ever! Make sure to try out the Unfair, Expert, and Legendary settings if you want an even greater challenge. 

[h3]Additional Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added additional new player UI prompts.
[*] Changed Upgrade Action ability to require ability selection to reduce player confusion.
[*] Added options to speed up animations.
[*] Added new Platinum badge for first place. (This will be retroactively granted for past first place players.)
[*] Added Pass and Play Game History.
[*] Added ‘Average Turns per Game’ to player history. (These will not apply to past games.)
[*] Improved hinting for enclosures in the build tray.
[*] Improved Action Button colors to represent action level, even if unavailable.
[*] Added option to display icons with a ‘0’ when at that value.
[*] Rearranged graphic layout when mousing over an action so the current action level is more obvious.
[*] Added animation when an opponent draws a card from the deck.
[*] Improved End of Game experience to be more readable and more dramatic.
[*] Several performance improvements.
[*] Added additional interaction options when building an enclosure.
[*] Several UI and hinting improvements.
[*] Special enclosures will now have animal icons when they are filled.
[*] Updated icons on special enclosures to have proper orientation.
[*] Improved the flow for the Commercial Harbor ability.
[*] Updated AI iconography for harder AIs.
[*] Improved VFX and UI around the Break and Breaking.
[*] Added missing stingers for opponent actions to help improve visibility during their turn.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] A number of outstanding gamepad, localization, UI and various art and graphic display issues have been addressed.
[*] Your turn should no longer be skipped when undoing all actions.
[*] Veterinarian should now show the correct value when moused over.
[*] Fixes and Improvements for tutorial prompts when encountering a feature for the first time.
[*] Sponsorship Drive challenge should now display losses correctly.
[*] Timing out on the first turn should correctly remove the timed-out player from the match.
[*] The Snap ability from Waza Small Animal Program should now be declinable.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game reloaded if left idle.
[*] Pass and Play games should now appear in player stats.
[*] The last player to join a game should now be able to select their player color and avatar.
[*] Adjusted default graphic settings on OSX devices.
[*] Fixed an issue where some cards were not displaying the icons they granted.
[*] The end game trophy should no longer obscure tiebreaker information.
[*] Adjusted chat preview messages to be less obtrusive.
[*] Clicking the chat preview bubble should now consistently open the chat.
[*] Long user names should no longer overlap other UI.
[*] Fixed an issue where you couldn’t edit avatars and colors for player 2 thru 4 in Pass and Play lobbies.
[*] Hinting for Breeding Program should now display correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where notifications showing enclosures were too dark.
[*] Player avatar and colors should now be represented correctly on the playmat.
[*] Waza Special Assignment should now properly grab petting zoo cards from the top of the deck.
[*] Tickets Required rules mod should now be able to place animals consistently..
[*] Fixed an issue where Outdoor Areas granted Conservation bonuses.
[*] You should no longer get a notification that it’s ‘Your Turn’ when the game ends.
[*] Added last turn warning for all players in Pass and Play games.
[*] Fixed an issue with Guided School Tours during the Sponsorship Drive challenge.
[*] Fixed some ambiguous income sources when mousing over your income.
[*] Adjusted the resolution of some card images.
[*] Polar Bear Exhibit and Science Lab should now use the correct symbol to track granted bonuses.
[*] Fixed an issue where opponent’s hand and Final Scoring card backs were not visible.
[*] Adjusted UI around obtaining a 3rd/4th Partner Zoo if you haven’t upgraded your Association action.
[*] Updated some colors to be more colorblind friendly.
[*] Removed the number in the Finish column in Game History for Special Exhibit matches.
[*] Always Show Icons is now available as a player preference.
[*] Tooltips for AI Difficulties and Map Mode options should now appear consistently and correctly.
[*] You can now mouse over starting hand cards.
[*] Added tooltip to Ice Cream Parlor map effect sign.
[*] Improved UI around moving animals to special enclosures.
[/list]

As always, we’d love any feedback you may have to share [url=https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital]via Discord[/url] or in the Steam forums, and if you run into trouble please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com so we can help.

Thanks for playing [i]Ark Nova Digital[/i]!

notes.title: Ark Nova 0.8.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/7fc3abd3d6709982a0963b06f11fa9c808a9c435.jpg[/img]

Greeting, fellow zookeepers! 

We’re feeding the animals, cleaning up the spaces, and spraying those pesky bugs to ensure the smoothest gameplay!
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3][list]
[*] Special enclosures should now enforce water and rock requirements when trying to move animals into them.
[*] Federal Grants should now correctly grant the Conservation Bonus if the user meets the reputation requirement.
[*] Easy AI should now properly reflect its intended difficulty.
[/list][h3]UI[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the Tight Schedule challenge where players couldn't use X-tokens to take a different action if their Association action was on 5 and they had no workers.
[*] Fixed an issue where restarting a Challenge wouldn't properly load Challenge conditions.
[*] Your avatar and color selections will now appear in the game for Challenges.
[*] Miscellaneous improvements to the tutorial.
[/list][h3]Localization[/h3][list]
[*] Miscellaneous localization corrections.
[/list][/list]
Thank you for your continued support! During the beta period, we appreciate all sorts of feedback to improve everyone’s gaming experience! You can join the conversation on Steam, [url=https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital]Discord[/url], or by shooting us an email-support@direwolfdigital.com!

notes.title: Ark Nova .8.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/7055d1ccb6529e0b9b47b2e620a99faf7c2511be.jpg[/img]


Here’s one present you get to unwrap early! We’ve got our final patch of the year jingling your way, complete with bug fixes and more. Huzzah! 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Competitive map mode (where players are given the same random advanced map) is now called “Mirrored”.
[*] The Breeding Program and Global Breeding Program Sponsor cards can now be used together to support a base conservation project.
[*] Each player gets a final turn when the endgame is triggered during a break.
[*] Aquarium should now correctly give 4 appeal when played.
[*] When releasing an animal, players are able to choose which enclosure to empty when multiple are valid.
[*] When moving animals into a Reptile House, the correct number of enclosures are now emptied.
[*] Players should now gain income abilities of cards which were played during that break.
[*] The Explorer Challenge now recognizes icons from sources other than animal cards for the purposes of winning and triggering the endgame.
[*] Architectural Zoo now scores correctly if you cover your water and rock spaces using Diversity Researcher.
[*] You can no longer gain your map fill bonus again using Diversity Researcher.
[/list]


Thank you for playing [i]Ark Nova Digital![/i]

notes.title: Ark Nova .8.2 Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/656018993025748d99490ece860afab1439dcba1.jpg[/img]

We’ve got another hotfix today to help smooth out your gaming experience! Unleash the wild!

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gameplay: Enclosures should now always move as expected when using a Gamepad. 
[*] Gameplay: Sponsorship cards should no longer track values as money.
[*] Gameplay: When the map is completely covered, the Architectural Zoo final scoring card should now grant a 1 Conservation bonus at end of the game. 
[*] Gameplay: When a player uses the Pouch ability given by map and then undoes the action, the player should now get the cards they pouched back (specific to undoing the Conservation Project).
[*] Gameplay: Players can no longer perform the same Association action twice in the same action. 
[*] Client: The space next to the commercial Harbor should now be able to be selected. 
[*] Gameplay: Sponsor Ability should now trigger Primates income correctly.
[*] Gameplay: Geologist should now give Appeal correctly for Rock icons.
[*] Gameplay: Engineer should now award 5 Appeal if map is completely covered. 
[*] Gameplay: Player should now be able to Upgrade actions or gain Reputation in any order. 
[*] Gameplay: Side Entrance should now give income for adjacent, occupied Standard Enclosures
[*] Gameplay: Player should now be prompted to use Flock Animal Ability when playing Moose. 
[*] Various backend fixes for Tutorials to prevent game freezing. 
[*] Hud: Players should no longer see double ‘Continue’ buttons when using the Commercial Harbor Ability. 
[*] A combination of Appeal, Money, and X-Tokens should resolve automatically with no player selection. 
[*] Challenges: Heroic Waza Challenge should now end when player completes the 8 Appeal required and normal end game goals. 
[*] Gameplay: Geologist and Hydrologist should now award money correctly for space-covering abilities. 
[*] Challenges: Player should now be able to trigger endgame if they have 5 animal category icons and 5 continent icons in their zoo.
[/list]

notes.title: Ark Nova .8.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292642/656018993025748d99490ece860afab1439dcba1.jpg[/img]


Thank you everyone for a great first day of [i]Early Access[/i] for[b][i] Ark Nova Digital[/i][/b]!  The team has been hard at work, and we have a quick hotfix for you to fix a few key issues! 
 
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Gameplay:  If you use the Hunter ability and wind up with all non-animal cards, those should now be discarded.
[*] Gameplay: Expert in small animals should now count Petting Zoo Animals for its 3 money discount. 
[*] Client: Players should now be able to decline Optional actions when resolving them. 
[*] Client: Players should now be able to select Player in Chat, Add Friend, or Block.
[*] Client: Using Undo after resuming a match should no longer result in blank window
[*] Client: Tooltip related to the Digging ability should now be localized. 
[*] Steam Deck: Tapping a text entry field should now bring up the keyboard and a Please Enter Text prompt. 
[*] Steam Deck: You should now be able to close the Create Account button with the B button.
[*] Steam Deck: You should now see the L-stick icon closer to the map selection window. 
[/list]
